purpose: Controlled qualification traffic for a declared Python owner-read cohort; not natural population sampling or workflow success before/after

host-adapter-metadata.scope: Devbox host adapter under its own UID with its existing profile /etc/agentops/host-adapter/vuoro-profile.json (profile id devbox-inbox-native-vuoro-shared, source_environment_id devbox), after root rollout/review; any other profile refuses before a request
host-adapter-metadata.sequence_evidence: host_adapter.inspect_owner opens one released client per call: handshake GET then catalog GET. Budget 2 preflight + 5 trials x 2 = 12.

served-cli-inbox-read.entrypoint: installed sprintctl.cli:cli with exact arguments message read --after-seq 0 --limit 1
served-cli-inbox-read.scope: Workstation inbox identity profile environment-record/profiles/workstation-inbox-native-vuoro-shared.json (profile id workstation-inbox-native-vuoro-shared, source_environment_id workstation; work:read + work:evidence) and the existing repo binding. The workstation maintenance profile (workstation-vuoro-shared) has no principal/workspace inbox and refuses before a request. No instance selector or changed cursor; CLI output discarded in memory
served-cli-inbox-read.sequence_evidence: Sprintctl 0.21.0 (commit ca3aa1b, #2822): served._invoke_operation builds a fresh client per call and runs handshake() before invoke(); the released client's invoke() fetches the catalog before the POST, so each trial is handshake GET, catalog GET, read invocation POST (sprintctl tests/test_served_invoke_handshake_oracle.py asserts this order for message read). Budget 2 preflight + 5 trials x 3 = 17. Sprintctl 0.20.0 sent catalog+invoke only (12 requests) and is refused; any other binding or sequence refuses until plan revision.
served-cli-inbox-read.repository_context: Run from existing canonical Agentops checkout with its served repo marker; do not create a marker or pass markerless bypass.

required: Exact approved plan SHA-256 and fixed executable/module version+hash bindings
Profile id, revision, source environment, target endpoint/environment and required authorities equal the mode's profile_binding (credential_ref never read or bound)
Exact catalog contract match for selected read operation, including read semantics/work:read/idempotency not-allowed/repo scope
Pinned approved metadata release/catalog digests and endpoint equality in memory; changed binding aborts
No execution before all local checks pass; no raw profile/endpoint/credential/ID values in output

transport_guard: Observe the actual HTTP client send boundary while preserving the released client's normal TLS/proxy transport setup
Only fixed method/path sequence; no redirects/query variants or unlisted operations
Before POST, require exact read operation, args and existing repo binding; require null idempotency/basis fields; unknown invocation fields refuse
Bound streamed response bytes and remaining time, classify errors without copying response/error text
Stop on first binding/permission/schema/transport/size refusal; status refused when nothing was sent, incomplete (completed samples and every admitted request kept) once anything was sent
Request Accept-Encoding identity, refuse encoded responses, and label body bytes only; preserve default TLS/proxy setup. Compression/performance population is outside this cohort.
retained_metrics: Public source/package/version identities, approved plan digest, metadata contract/release digests
Mode, trial index, elapsed duration, HTTP method+fixed route, status class, HTTP version and bounded TLS version enum
Request/response BODY bytes only, separately labeled canonical argument bytes; no claim of full wire/TLS byte counts
Aggregate JSON node type counts, total string UTF-8 bytes, array/object counts, max depth and max array length; no keys or scalar values
Read result message count bounded 0..1; empty is recorded as empty and not treated as evidence of a populated workload
Observed in-flight count and explicitly controlled sequential concurrency; source configured limits separately labeled
Observed metadata-only path vs read invocation path, timing window and proxy-configuration presence only
tests_before_live: Mutation operation, altered read args, unknown envelope fields, redirect or endpoint change never reach the underlying transport
Actual released Sprintctl 0.21.0 CLI fixture produces only handshake, catalog and read invocation per trial (17 requests per mode), no message receipt or local state write
Actual host-adapter inspector fixture produces only two metadata GETs
Secret sentinel bodies/keys/errors and credential headers are absent from report; shape aggregation retains no values
Empty inbox, 403, 503, oversized/slow response, elapsed budget and count cap stay distinct, bounded and fail closed
Explicit per-request timeout, wall cap, request-count cap and handshake-sequence budget each refuse; a failure after any request is reported incomplete with completed samples kept
Installed or planned Sprintctl 0.20.0 refuses before any network request
live_gate: Root reviews exact implementation+plan packet before sampling. No live cohort sampling authorized yet.
exclusions: production throughput or p95 claims from five samples
effective authority beyond the exact read observed
full EC01 completion or interface retirement
ec00_handoff: Bind the observed read-size classes and conditions to this controlled cohort before choosing benchmark cases; retain stress cases as explicitly synthetic and run all candidates identically. Other inventory unknowns remain retirement holds.
